Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological variable is mechanical stress induced via EPS. While the ontology mapping for EPS is placed under fluid_shear_stress as a proxy for mechanical force, it is specifically electrical pulse stimulation. The study also uses several small molecule inhibitors to validate the phosphatase/kinase axis.
